Parfums de Marly · AI says:

If your purchase or choice doesn’t work out, you have several options, depending on your situation:

Return your online order: You may return Parfums de Marly products bought on our official website within 28 days after delivery, as long as items are unused, sealed, and in original packaging, and the entire order is returned including complimentary gifts (excluding 1.5 ml samples). Discovery Sets are not eligible for return or exchange, and return shipping costs are your responsibility.
Exchange your online order: Within 28 days after delivery, eligible online purchases can be exchanged if products are unused and in original packaging. Exchanges must be of an identical or lower amount, and the whole order, including complimentary gifts (excluding 1.5 ml samples), must be returned. Return shipping costs are at your expense. Discovery Sets cannot be exchanged.
No boutique returns for website orders: Items bought on our official website cannot be returned in boutiques. Returns and exchanges must be processed through our online process.
Try before fully committing: If you are unsure a fragrance will work for you, we recommend exploring our discovery tools first:
Use our online fragrance-finding immersive experience to help select a scent aligned with your tastes and occasions.
Order our Masculine or Feminine Discovery Sets, which allow you to test multiple fragrances at home. These sets are 100% redeemable on your next purchase of any full-size fragrance (75 ml, 125 ml, or 200 ml), giving you credit toward a bottle once you’re confident in your choice.
You can also visit our stores or authorized retailers to try fragrances in person before deciding on a full-size bottle.

These options are designed to give you flexibility—either by returning or exchanging qualifying online orders within the specified conditions and timeframe, or by discovering and testing fragrances through discovery sets and in-store experiences before you commit to a full-size bottle.
